text:
```yaml
name: copilot-setup-steps

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup Node.js and Install Dependencies
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        id: cache-dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.pnpm-store
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build all packages via Turbo
        run: pnpm turbo run build --filter=* --parallel
```
